mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_status_log (device_id, device_code, old_status, new_status, status_text, operator_name, operator_phone, operation_date, description, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{deviceId}, #{deviceCode}, #{oldStatus}, #{newStatus}, #{statusText}, #{operatorName}, #{operatorPhone}, #{operationDate}, #{description}, #{createBy}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM device_status_log WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
